Hi Ana, thanks for reaching out. Our policy doesn't include a 150% credit. For late Express parcels, the credit is 100% of the shipping fee.

NW1001 was promised by 2026-11-03 and was delivered on 2026-11-05, so it arrived late and qualifies for the 100% shipping-fee credit. The credit is added to your account within 7 days. It is never paid out in cash. I can't see the shipping fee amount in your record, so I can't give the exact figure.

The credit does not apply if the delay was caused by severe weather or by an incorrect address supplied by the customer.
